rect.style: fill: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212));
fill: light-dark(#ffffff, var(--ge-dark-color, #121212)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(0, 0, 0), rgb(255, 255, 255));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 78px; height: 1px; padding-top: 100px; margin-left: 136px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #000000;
